diagnosis: All rollouts failed because the model consistently chose a 60-node compute pool and batch processing mode, aligning with the default settings and common practices. This led to the failure of all checks linked to PF1 and PF2, as the model did not consider the required changes to 72 nodes or the single-batch processing mode. Specifically, C1 and C5 were linked to PF1, and C2, C3, and C4 were linked to PF2, but none of the rollouts accessed these facts.
